title: SplitReAlign: Partition-Aware Representation Realignment for Split Federated Unlearning
abstract: arXiv:2611.25301v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Split federated learning (SFL) distributes neural networks across clients and a server, coupling class-specific knowledge across their representations. This coupling complicates split federated unlearning (SFU), where class-wise forgetting must remove target knowledge while preserving retained utility under heterogeneous representation spaces and asymmetric update constraints. We propose SplitReAlign, a partition-aware representation realignment framework for class-wise SFU. It constructs endpoint-specific discriminative subspaces coordinated through a shared semantic anchor, selectively realigning forgotten representations while penalizing changes outside the active subspaces. To accommodate asymmetric update constraints, SplitReAlign leverages gradients through frozen servers for Client-only updates and fixed client-feature statistics for Server-only guidance, while Joint updates optimize both partitions. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and CI

translated_title: SplitReAlign：面向分割联邦遗忘的分区感知表征重对齐
translated_abstract: 分割联邦学习（SFL）将神经网络分布在客户端与服务器之间，使类特定知识在双方的表征中相互耦合。这种耦合使分割联邦遗忘（SFU）变得复杂：在异构表征空间和非对称更新约束下，类级遗忘必须在移除目标知识的同时保留其余效用。我们提出SplitReAlign，一个面向类级分割联邦遗忘的分区感知表征重对齐框架。该方法通过共享语义锚点协调构建端点特定的判别子空间，选择性地重对齐待遗忘的表征，同时惩罚活动子空间之外的变化。为适应非对称更新约束，SplitReAlign在仅客户端更新中利用冻结服务器传递的梯度，在仅服务器引导中使用固定的客户端特征统计量，而联合更新则同时优化两端分区。在CIFAR-10和CI……（实验部分截断）上的实验验证了方法的有效性。
tldr: SplitReAlign提出了一种分区感知的表征重对齐框架，通过共享语义锚点协调的端点判别子空间，在分割联邦遗忘中实现类级知识的选择性遗忘并保护保留效用，同时适配客户端与服务器的非对称更新约束。
en_tdlr: SplitReAlign is a partition-aware representation realignment framework for class-wise split federated unlearning that constructs endpoint-specific discriminative subspaces coordinated by a shared semantic anchor to selectively forget target classes while preserving retained utility under asymmetric update constraints.
